top_signals.title: Gold Edges Up as Traders Weigh Mideast Conflict, Fed Rate Path
top_signals.summary: Gold edged higher, holding firmly above the key resistance point of $4,000 an ounce even as the widening conflict in the Middle East fuels expectations for tighter monetary policy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Travelers Draws Wave of Bears as Stock Eyes Best Year Since 2000
top_signals.summary: The best year for Travelers Companies Inc. shares in more than 25 years has unleashed a bevy of downgrades as Wall Street bets that the stock’s gains have peaked.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
